node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 positive 433-1b universal xi4/xi3 outside-role transport
node.closure: exact xi4-to-xi3 system bijection in every common role cell, source sign, target lane, and canonical matching
node.statement: For every guarded positive deployed 433-1b common role cell, source sign, target lane, and canonical matching, the signed outside-coordinate involution (d,e,f) -> (sigma_o e,sigma_o d,f) maps the complete system with missing sigma_o ef record xi=4 bijectively to the system with missing df record xi=3. It transposes exactly atlas rows 3 and 4 while fixing the other product and squared-sum rows, the compact residual order, matching index, target guards, sign-cycle invariants, source signs, and all 15 common role cells. Thus any proved xi3 exclusion block transports at identical scope to xi4. This theorem proves only the transport; it does not itself exclude xi3 or xi4 in an open role cell.
